title: Axefall - A roguelite with Elden Ring style boss fights
author: chillinoncherokee
selftext:
I’m putting the final touches on my new iOS game Axefall. It has multiple maps and enemies, and every map has its own unique boss with different timing and abilities. 

Each chapter has 5 levels of difficulty and you can toggle on hard mode for a real challenge. 

As an Elden Ring fan, I wanted the boss fights to have some familiarity with that. Beating the harder bosses on higher levels have a super satisfying feeling. A lot of work went into balancing and small touches. 

Just wanted to share it here and get some initial feedback! If you’d like to keep up with when it launches on iOS (very soon) follow the IG: 

(@axefallgame) https://www.instagram.com/axefallgame?mdxt=M2pybmJrMjYwZXd2&utm\_source=qr

comments.author: MeaningBoring
comments.body: cool, did you make the model with ai or you bought premade one?

replies.author: chillinoncherokee
replies.body:
I have some bought assets and also I’ve built them with ai in blender as well. 

I’m also working on an RPG that’s a brother game to Axefall with a lot of custom assets built with ai. It’s a big world and a lot of systems going into it.
